test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct option is "varied".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Let us look into **meaning **of the given options - 

 
 
• hurried - done (too) quickly.
 
• varied - having many different kinds of things or activities.
 
• dread - to be very afraid of or worried about something.
 
• concrete - real or definite.
 
 
 
• The sentence with the blank points out how sport fans display different emotions to their favorite team.
 
• So, **'**varied' is the most appropriate word for the given blank. 
 
• The rest of the options are contextually inappropriate.
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer. 

Correct Paragraph:__ *Allegiance to one’s favourite team is something that sports fans (1) __develop__* *over a period of time. They are so attached to their favourite teams that they could display **(2) __varied__** emotions, not just during the course of the match, but much after the actual event is over. This phenomenon, (3) ______ common across the globe, is more seen in countries like Brazil, India, the US and even the UK, where the favourite sport may not be the same in each of these nations. In spite of this craze and hysteria, sport has (4) ______ a long way. It is accepted as one of the world’s most (5) ______ pastimes ever.*
